AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 56 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7721, #7722, #7723, #7730 and #7733. All five are merged PRs and now carry the read-back `audit:complete` label:

- #7721 → #6827: canonical Turso DB creation/conversion docs; issue remains open by design until Turso adds the missing CLI verb.
- #7722 → #2043/#2296: ID token design extension, including the pending-unit trading ruling.
- #7723 → #3238/#3270/#3240/#3283: all four remaining mirror-contract children completed.
- #7730 → #7725: surrogate-safe activity summary caps.
- #7733 → #7731: surrogate-safe comment author/body caps.

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7721-7733/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7721-7733.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 56 valid PRs audited from 60 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 190 identifiers remain, next #7734. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
